card.fact_statement: The Corpus Christi Catholic Church was destroyed by the Palisades Fire.
card.source_span: Destroyed or heavily damaged structures included the Community United Methodist Church of Pacific Palisades, Pacific Palisades Presbyterian Church, Corpus Christi Catholic Church
